$comment: SHA-256 of each published provider binary, keyed by provider id and then
by Rust target triple. Compiled into the desktop and pinned into every
launch bundle it issues; buzz-waker selects the entry for the platform it
runs on and refuses anything else (G1).
Kept here rather than fetched at issuance so that issuing a bundle needs
no network, and so a change to what the owner authorizes is a reviewable
diff rather than whatever a release happened to serve that day.
MUST be bumped together with Dockerfile.waker's PROVIDER_SPRITES_TAG. The
daemon can only run a binary this file authorizes, so a version bump on
one side alone means every wake fails with a digest mismatch. Values come
Bumping invalidates bundles issued under the old version: reissue by
toggling Remote wake off and on, or by any config change.
